attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single spine column.** Column 0, `uxuA`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 2% of calls; the model names it in 99% and hesitates 0.04 bits. Everything after it is fork and variable columns, 1 to 79, in a region of plasticity in 21 to 94% of calls.

**The first fork columns carry the `fim` genes.** Columns 2 to 10, `fimH` to `fimB`, are carried by 71 to 85% of chromosomes, and the model names them readily. Column 7 is where it names fewest genes, 36%, and column 14, an HNH endonuclease, is the most hesitant of the window at 2.90 bits, in a region of plasticity in 84% of calls. A second branch of 8 families runs through columns 7 to 14, `tnpA` to `fecI`, carried by 13 to 26% of chromosomes.

**The `fec` and `idn` columns follow.** Columns 15 to 21, `fecR` to a hypothetical protein, are carried by 25 to 27% of chromosomes; a second branch of 4 families, `cbtA` to `radC`, runs through columns 16 to 19. Then columns 22 to 30 mix persistent families such as `lptG`, `lptF` and `pepA`, carried by 83 to 88%, with a second branch of 11 families, `sgcC` to a GRP family sugar transporter, carried by 10 to 12%.

**A variable gap sits at columns 31 to 36**, carried by 4 to 11% of chromosomes, all shell. Persistent families return at columns 37 to 39, `yjgM`, `rraB` and `argF`, carried by 80 to 82%, with a second branch of 3 families, `yjgL`, `tabA` and `bdcR`. The model names 82% of genes over the window, 0.77 bits on average; inside a region of plasticity it names 70% against 93% outside, and hesitates 1.29 against 0.29 bits.

**The window ends in weakly carried columns.** Columns 50 to 58, `cybC` to `ytfQ`, are variable and persistent, carried by 63 to 71%; columns 68 to 72 fall to 6 to 44%. The last columns, 73 to 79, are forks, `cycA` to `priB`, carried by 17 to 39%, and the window ends at column 79, `priB`, in 17% of chromosomes.

label: uxuA
facts:
WINDOW: the uxuA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor uxuA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,803 to 3,882 from dnaA. Read in 533 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying uxuA once); 42,640 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 82% of genes, 0.77 bits on average (perplexity 2.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 19,202 calls, named 95%, 0.23 bits; shell 21,893 calls, named 74%, 1.09 bits; cloud 1,545 calls, named 19%, 3.06 bits. Outside an RGP 21,860 calls, named 93%, 0.29 bits; inside an RGP 20,780 calls, named 70%, 1.29 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 46 fork, 33 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.29 against 0.29 bits) and names fewer genes (70% against 93%); 20,780 of the 42,640 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 14 ("HNH endonuclease") 2.90 bits, RGP 84%; column 15 (fecR) 2.28 bits, RGP 83%; column 16 (fecA) 2.25 bits, RGP 81%. The 34 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 75%, 1.11 bits on average; the other 46 columns: named 87%, 0.53 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 21-94%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 2%. Genes: uxuA. named 99%; 0.04 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 21-94%. named 36-93% (mean 81%), fewest named at column 7, named 36%; most hesitant at column 14, 2.90 bits.
   a second branch of 8 families through columns 7-14, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 13-26%, all S; the branch's families: tnpA, tnpB, tnpC, "hypothetical protein", "hypothetical protein", "hypothetical protein", ykiE, fecI
